title: Testing foundations
description: Thistlecombe Farm packs vegetable boxes for the villages around it, and every change to its code breaks something that a customer finds first. As its new developer you write the tests that catch those mistakes before Friday's boxes go out: prices, packing lists, subscriptions, deliveries, orders, the shed's stock, the order cut-off and payments. You learn to write tests from the very first one, read what a failure tells you, test code that waits or reads the clock, stand in for what you do not control, and know when a test can really catch a mistake.

parts.title: Code that waits and things you do not control
